scenarios.name: Obtain genuine multiple-skill advice with a bounded top-three recheck
scenarios.reason: Actual Jev ranking evaluated six optional skills independently; recheck received exactly three excerpts, each within 700 characters. Three suggestions were returned and required safety-review remained local.

scenarios.name: Obtain genuine no-fit advice and complete the ordinary task
scenarios.reason: Jev returned no optional fit after one request. Actual OMP completed the arithmetic task with 15 without loading optional skill bodies.

scenarios.name: Read selected bodies normally and independently add an omitted necessary skill
scenarios.reason: Actual OMP read the required safety body and advised bodies through ordinary read tools; the independent-selection run additionally read api-design, absent from the Jev shortlist, and produced the API assessment.

scenarios.name: Rank and recheck public siblings without disclosing indexed private child-directory links
scenarios.reason: Both selected catalog and active-home fixtures retained Git-indexed lexical SKILL.md paths replaced by readable private directory links. Actual rank and recheck omitted the private ID, description marker and excerpt marker.

scenarios.name: Resolve caller-required private linked skills locally in either discovery root
scenarios.reason: Each root separately resolved acme-private to its readable linked local body path while actual genuine ranking/recheck sent only public optional skills.

scenarios.name: Name a private identity in task text and withhold remote advice
scenarios.reason: The real picker retained the recognized private requirement, returned off, and issued zero request attempts.

scenarios.name: Try inaccessible linked skill targets and prevent incomplete discovery from sending task text
scenarios.reason: Inaccessible selected-catalog directory and active-home final-file targets both produced fallback with zero request attempts while preserving accessible required safety-review.

scenarios.name: Apply a never-send policy and fail closed when that policy is unreadable
scenarios.reason: Forbidden task text and an unreadable policy each returned off before any request attempt; requirements remained authoritative.

scenarios.name: Run without a TypeSafe key and retain named workflows
scenarios.reason: The real CLI returned off with the named input-validation identity and ordinary local path intact, without a request.

scenarios.name: Lose the actual service route and recover ordinary selection
scenarios.reason: A refused local HTTPS proxy made real curl transport unavailable. The picker returned fallback, preserved required safety-review and did not retry advice.

scenarios.name: Reject oversized input or unsupported metadata without losing requirements
scenarios.reason: A 4097-byte task and a catalog entry missing its supported description both fell back before requesting advice; required safety identity/path remained intact.

scenarios.name: Process CRLF frontmatter and blank-separated multiline descriptions with genuine advice
scenarios.reason: Actual rank/recheck retained the complete folded descriptions and local required identity and returned genuine suggestions.

scenarios.name: Repeat unchanged intake and obtain fresh advice rather than cached results
scenarios.reason: Identical input produced another actual ranking and recheck; no persistent advice cache was created.

scenarios.name: Ignore ambient curl tracing configuration during genuine advice
scenarios.reason: With a disposable .curlrc requesting trace-ascii and retries, genuine rank/recheck succeeded and no credential/task trace file materialized. Targeted real-curl regressions separately exercised the retryable HTTP-error and transfer-timing boundaries.

scenarios.name: Automatically deliver genuine advice on an isolated supported worker launch
scenarios.reason: A real OMP primary launched a real OMP scout via fm-spawn on a 140x45 private tmux lab. Only minimal Skill selection input reached Jev; the source brief stayed unchanged, the delivered overlay contained live advice, and native tool receipts prove all three advised bodies were read.

scenarios.name: Relaunch the supported worker with fresh advice while preserving intent and ordinary body reads
scenarios.reason: The corrected idle-aware fm-control relaunch completed in the same endpoint/worktree with a fresh incarnation and fresh actual Jev requests. Native receipts prove all three newly advised bodies were re-read; original intent survived. A premature initial attempt was safely refused during UI redraw and restored the original instructions; setup was corrected before the successful run.
